Message:
staging: rtl8723bs: use WLAN_EID_VENDOR_SPECIFIC

Replace unique WLAN_EID_GENERIC, _WPA_IE_ID_, _SSN_IE_1_, and
_VENDOR_SPECIFIC_IE_ macros with kernel provided WLAN_EID_VENDOR_SPECIFIC
from linux/ieee80211.h.
